maps.points.undertower.detail-5: Torren's wounds close before your eyes. Broken bones knit beneath his skin.
maps.points.undertower.detail-7: At (-1, -12) Enemies have stepped on it
maps.points.undertower.detail-8: When Torren is pushed into the teleportation gate, the ending will be triggered. When the Great Wizard is still alive, achievements will be unlocked simultaneously.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue: How deep beneath the tower have you come?
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-10: His voice is calm. Almost pleased. You recognize it.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-12: So you finally chose to enter the tower. (once only)
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-17: "Names matter only to those who fear being forgotten."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-2: Then, without warning, the stairs end.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-20: Choose “So you finally chose to enter the tower.”
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-21: A faint smile crosses his face.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-29: "The end of a very long effort."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-3: The passage beneath the tower opens into a vast hall, its pillars lost in shadow, their tops swallowed by darkness.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-31: "I wondered which of you would make it this far."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-32: "Tell me... who do you think led all those brave little adventurers here?"
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-33: "Whispers of treasures, ruins, dragons, and forgotten power... until fools came running with swords in hand?"
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-34: "I have spent centuries weaving this. Thread by thread."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-35: A smile cuts across his face.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-36: "And you danced so beautifully along the web."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-37: Torren looks almost disappointed that there is no more audience here to properly appreciate his genius.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-39: Can you skip that part and tell us what lies beyond the portal? (once only)
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-4: A stone arch, ancient and impossible, pulsing with deep crimson light.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-42: For the first time, the invader seems almost pleased.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-43: "Good. Then perhaps I no longer have to speak in riddles."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-44: "Four ancient guardians carried the burden of the seals."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-46: For the first time, genuine irritation flickers across his face.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-47: "Do you have any idea how long I have waited for this moment?"
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-49: "I spent centuries breaking the seals of this world while people like you unknowingly did the work for me."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-51: "Beyond it waits an army, my servants. I intend to open the way and claim what was promised."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-52: Choose “Go on.” (Mounds that have been processed “The Source? ”)
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-53: "... the Source beneath the graveyard... gone at last."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-54: "An entire order dedicated its existence to that task."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-55: "Then you arrived, walked into the heart of the cult, and finished the task for me."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-56: Choose “Go on.” (Mounds that have not been processed “The Source? ”)
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-57: "The Source beneath the Mausoleum is still alive."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-58: "You have dealt with the cult and its mind now wanders through madness and dreams."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-59: "It can no longer protects the tower."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-6: Within it, a curtain of red light flickers and tears, as if the space itself cannot hold together.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-61: "The mire beast is dead too, I hear."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-62: "You have a remarkable talent for removing obstacles while believing the choice was your own."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-64: "You freed it from Grimfen and its bond to the tower was broken."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-66: "The dwarves I broke prepared the way. You delivered the final blow. Better than I expected."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-67: "The dragon yet lives. Irritating... but not fatal. Distance has weakened its hold on the tower's defenses."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-68: "The Last Guardian... even I could not bring him down."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-69: "So I bred a race of blood-drinkers."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-7: A figure stands before it. Focused.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-71: "Centuries spent seeking a way to get him. In the end, all I needed was enough bugs."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-72: "Then I placed his key into your hands, and you did exactly what I had hoped."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-74: What lies beyond that portal? (once only)
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-75: Why are you doing this? (once only)
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-76: Select “Can you skip that section?, Tell us directly what lies behind the portal.” / “What lies beyond that portal?”
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-77: He turns his eyes to the red light.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-80: You are going to destroy everything. (once only)
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-82: "This world was sealed... and left to wither in its own fear."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-83: "They will just take what was promised... and remake this world in the taking."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-84: Choose “You are going to destroy everything.”
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-85: He looks at you, almost amused.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-9: ".... you made it further than the others."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-90: The red light swells behind him.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-92: "I was hoping you would say that."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-95: Fangs bare. Eyes burn. No longer Torren.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-96: Shapes begin to emerge from the crimson light.
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-97: "You came all this way to stop me. Don't disappoint me now."
maps.points.undertower.dialogue-98: Yet the assault has staggered him. He drops to one knee. Not from weakness, but disbelief.
maps.points.undertower.e01.detail: The tile at (14, -19) activates when the party or an enemy steps on it, or when an item or another object holds it down.
maps.points.undertower.f01.detail: In "Torren Malik's Final Meeting," this individual is mentioned, but the level information does not specify his appearance conditions.
maps.points.undertower.f02.detail: In "Torren Malik's Final Meeting," choosing "Enough. Die" or "That's it" will advance the dialogue to the start of the battle.
maps.points.undertower.title: Torren Malik's final encounter
maps.points.undertower.title-3: Branch that pushes Torren into the teleporter
